statements.statement: Town is restarting FY21 budgets on level-service basis; school to review proposed new positions, salary reserve, health insurance and purchases.
Proposed school budget to go to School Committee in late April, then Finance Committee (last meeting April 30th), town manager hearing May 7th, then town meeting.
